::: {#def-relu}

#### Rectified linear unit (ReLU)

The **rectified linear unit**, or **ReLU**, is the [activation function](#def-activation-function)

$$
\operatorname{ReLU}(z) = \maxf{0, z}
$$

[@nair2010rectified; @goodfellow2016deep, section 6.3.1].
PyTorch provides it as `torch.relu` and as the layer `nn.ReLU()`.
In mathematics $\maxf{0, z}$ is also called the positive part of $z$,
written $z^+$.
*Deep Learning* recommends ReLU as the default activation function for [hidden layers](#def-hidden-layer) [@goodfellow2016deep, section 6.1]. <!-- check-term-links: allow -->

:::
